citation: Bienkowski M.S., Bowman I., Song M.Y. et al. Integration of gene expression and brain-wide connectivity reveals the multiscale organization of mouse hippocampal networks. Nat. Neurosci. 21, 1628-1643 (2018).
asterisk_note: Shown as in Supplementary Table 2; the paper and its supplement do not state what the asterisk marks.

signatures.definition: signature = mean over the column's marker genes of ISH/p99.5 (clip 1); contrast = signature minus the mean over genes annotated in other columns of the same group but not this one (clip 0); x255, inside CA/DG/SUB/ProS/FC/IG + 6 voxels

stack50.definition: ISH / p99.5 (clip 1), mean over 2x2x2 voxels -> 50 µm, inside CA/DG/SUB/ProS/FC/IG, x255; row k = genes[k] (ISH volume names), column j = voxels[j] (50 µm indices from origin)
